display_name: Manulife Vietnam term life product terms (Điều khoản sản phẩm bảo hiểm tử kỳ có thời hạn): the whole document, Articles 1 to 18

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of the deposited rendering, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check finds verbatim in it. 162 distinct lines are quoted, each once, of 361 non-blank lines (SOURCE-LICENSE.md).

source.rendering: pdftotext, reading order, no -layout, of manulife-term-life.pdf; the PDF is two-column and src:N is a line of this rendering
source.authority: the insurer's own published product terms; private contract terms, not law

aids.what: Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15, read for LAW: forks only; not encoded. Its text in the aid ends at Article 130, without the transitional provisions.

scope: The whole document: Articles 1 to 18, every paragraph, the Art 3(b) table row by row. 48 coverage rows: 37 encoded (3 of them with a gap reached and refused), 8 inert (the title, two chapeaux, Art 2's list of documents, Art 6's currency, Art 8's disclaimer, Art 16's second end of the contract, Art 17's governing law), 3 reached-and-refused (Art 1.3's consequence, Art 5 before the first premium, Art 10's consequence), 0 out-of-scope, 0 deferred. Everything left to the contract page, the claim file, the riders' own terms or the Company's decisions is an input with no default. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: Art 1.5: the effective date (signing or acceptance) is taken from the contract page as an input.
forks.F2: Periods are calendar days, months and years; the start day is day 0 and the last day (start + N) is inside; month ends clamp.
forks.F3: ngày cấp (the issue date) is undefined and distinct from the effective date; an input.
forks.F5: Art 1.6: a death on the maturity date is covered.
forks.F6: Art 3(c)(i): the crime is the insured's own (the literal reading reaches anyone's: finding 1).
forks.F7: Art 3(a)(iii): premiums due and unpaid are deducted, not the year's modal premiums not yet due (finding 13).
forks.F8: Art 3(b): overlapping bands read as a first-match ladder; Age at death in the Art 1.4 sense.
forks.F9: Art 3(b) reduces limb (i) only; rider benefits are added and unpaid premiums deducted after it.
forks.F10: Refunds are of all premium paid and never below nil.
forks.F11: A misstated Age or sex is governed by Art 9, not Art 10.
forks.F12: Art 4: a request counts on the day it is sent; only a timely request on or before a death defeats cover.
forks.F13: Art 11: a suicide before the issue date is not within 2 years from it (finding 4).
forks.F14: Art 9: an underpaid premium reduces the sum insured in proportion.
forks.F15: Art 18(iv): termination at request on the day of the request; a death that day is covered.
forks.F16: Art 14: the application to reinstate must fall within the 2 years.
forks.F17: Art 16: the 2 months is the only payment deadline; interest after it whatever the cause; the interest amount is refused.
forks.F18: The composition's order; the claim time bar applies to the death benefit, not to refunds.
forks.F19: Art 5: only payment in full to the Company or its agent counts.
forks.F20: Art 10: the omission not itself later declared is a further condition.
forks.F21: Art 16: the year runs from the death; only the policyholder can extend it (finding 3).
forks.F22: Art 16: missing documents delay settlement; they do not defeat the claim.
forks.F23: Arts 3(c), 9, 11: the payee of a refund is not stated.
forks.F24: Art 8: one beneficiary takes all; stated shares are fractions.
forks.F25: Art 5: before the first premium the document is silent; refused (finding 15).
forks.F26: Ages: at the issue date for Arts 1.3 and 9, at the death for Art 3(b).
forks.L1: LAW: Art 4's 14 days against Law Art 35's 21; the document's 14 encoded.
forks.L2: LAW: Art 11 counts from the issue date, Law Art 40(1)(a) from the first premium; the document encoded.
forks.L3: LAW: Art 16's one year agrees with Law Art 30(1); Law Art 30(2) gives the discovery rule to the insured or beneficiary.
forks.L4: LAW: Law Art 31(1) gives 15 days to pay where none is agreed; the document's 2 months encoded.
forks.L5: LAW: Art 5 agrees with Law Art 37(2)-(3); Law Art 37(4) bars suing for premium.
forks.L6: LAW: Law Art 28(1) needs the insured's written consent to an assignment of life insurance; not a field.
forks.L7: LAW: Law Art 41(3) needs the insured's written consent to a change of beneficiary; not a field.
forks.L8: LAW: Art 17's 3 years; the aid has no limitation provision.
forks.L9: LAW: Law Arts 22(2) and 25(2) say what is returned on rescission or nullity; Art 10 does not (refused).
forks.L10: LAW: Law Art 40(1) lists statutory non-payment cases the document does not repeat; not encoded.
forks.L11: LAW: Law Art 39(2)(a) allows death cover on a minor with a parent's or guardian's consent; the document asks for the insured's signature.
forks.L12: LAW: Law Art 24 (contra proferentem) used to choose F4, F5, F6, F13.
